scope.comparators: Statuses of each recorded comparator, stratified by prespecified mutation activity. Not applicable is never a detected fault. No classifier sensitivity or clinical accuracy is inferred.
scope.denominators: Executed means a retained completed case record, including sampling unavailable. Unavailable = execution unavailable + sampling unavailable. Unreached cases remain in planned totals.
scope.drift: Signed candidate-minus-source and candidate-minus-correct-operation differences already recorded. They concern voxel counts, occupied volume, ROI mean and population variance, not extracted native radiomic features.
scope.primary_boundary: Materialized SimpleITK image/mask outputs; file roundtrip is separate.
scope.reuse: Recorded sampling-layer decision, not universal radiomic feature equality or clinical approval.
scope.runtime: Recorded elapsed times, with nonexecuted/unavailable measurements missing; volume attempts include failures.
scope.statistics: Descriptive distributions only, linear interpolation of empirical quantiles. No confidence intervals or independence assumption across volumes or operations.

source_run_metadata.acceptance_policy: Only status=satisfied is a satisfied sampling check; indeterminate_boundary and not_available are distinct from acceptance. Support and feature reuse remain separate decisions.
source_run_metadata.boundary: Native materialized image/mask outputs; separate prespecified NIfTI subset.
source_run_metadata.checkpoint_policy: Two constructed examples on first sorted ID of each dataset, without replacement.
source_run_metadata.grid_rationale: Clinical 1/2 mm grids plus 0.8 mm, fixed from known input-spacing metadata before outcome evaluation, to include fractional resampling of 1 mm MRI sources.
source_run_metadata.roundtrip_policy: All synthetic cases; first three lexicographically sorted IDs of every clinical dataset, without replacement.
source_run_metadata.target_origin_and_direction: Preserved from working source; no centring or outcome-dependent shift.
